🚨A novel way to do RL in LLM post-training! 

Inspired by our previous path-not-taken work (https://t.co/n7StFdRGDw), we dig deep into the learning trajectory of RL and find that optimizing singular vectors (i.e., rotation) of weight matrices suffices for good performance in RL. https://t.co/MvZjCLloz0
